title: sipnab operator notes file line
description: One line of an operator notes file (JSON Lines: one object per line), as written by the TUI's notes save and read by --notes. Written and read by src/annotate/mod.rs. A note is a person's text about one frame; sipnab writes it into a pcapng packet comment and never reads it back as analysis.

frame.description: The frame the note is about, as a sipnab frame pointer: <source>#<ordinal>, optionally @<digest> (16 hex digits, FNV-1a of the frame's bytes). The form the `frame` field of --json carries. --write-annotated refuses a pointer without a digest, because nothing could then prove the note lands on the frame it was written about. A byte-range suffix (+start-end) is refused: a note is about a whole frame.

note.description: The note text. At most 4096 BYTES of UTF-8 (maxLength counts characters and cannot express the byte cap). No control character other than newline and tab. A note holding an SDES inline: key, a TLS key-log line or a digest response= value is refused.
